a.lede: The FBI has confirmed that North Korean state-sponsored hackers known as TraderTraitor were behind the $6.3 billion crypto-theft attack on Binance, making it the largest cryptocurrency heist on record. [...]
a.title: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers

b.lede: Cybersecurity experts have long warned of the persistent and patient threat from North Korea's long-running hacks. The world's largest crypto exchange was still caught off-guard.
b.title: Researchers warned of North Korean hacking tactics years before record $6.3B Binance heist
